summary_en: Funai Consulting HD approved acquisition of up to 1.8 million shares (1.97% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥2.0 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 9, 2026 to March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Funai Consulting HD announced on November 6, 2026 that its board of directors approved a share repurchase program to acquire up to 1.8 million shares, representing 1.97% of outstanding shares (91,173,612 shares excluding treasury shares as of June 30, 2026), for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥2.0 billion. The shares will be purchased through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 9, 2026 to March 31, 2027. The company cited the need for flexible capital allocation in response to changing business environments, with the objectives of improving capital efficiency and enhancing shareholder returns.
